entities.summary: Biratnagar is a Metropolitan city in Nepal, which serves as the capital of the easternmost Koshi Province. With a Metropolitan Urban Agglomeration population of 244,750 per the 2021 census, it is the largest and the fastest growing city in the province. It is also the headquarters of the district of Morang. It is the administrative center of the Greater Birat Development Area which aims to connect Biratnagar with major nearby towns—including Itahari, Gothgau, Biratchowk, and Dharan—along the Koshi Highway, representing a combined, densely populated urban corridor sharing an estimated total population of 804,300 people across 159,332 households.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As the administrative center of the Greater Birat Development Area, Biratnagar plays a crucial role in connecting major nearby towns and facilitating economic growth. With an estimated total population of 804,300 people across 159,332 households, it is a significant urban hub in Nepal's eastern region.
